title: ITO: Multi-View Alignment and Training-Time Fusion for Image-Text Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2603.02767v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image--text contrastive pretraining has become a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning, yet existing methods often yield representations that remain partially organized by modality rather than by semantics. We propose ITO, a framework addressing this limitation through two complementary mechanisms with distinct roles. Multimodal multiple alignment enriches supervision by constructing diverse cross-modal correspondences from multi-view image augmentations, providing the primary source of discriminative gain. A lightweight training-time multimodal fusion module then acts as a training-time regularizer, encouraging the encoders to produce features that are compatible under fusion. Crucially, the fusion module is discarded at inference, preserving the efficiency of standard dual-encoder architectures while incurring training-time overhead only. Extensive experiments across pretraining scales from millions to billions

translated_title: ITO：面向图文预训练的多视图对齐与训练时融合
translated_abstract: 图文对比预训练已成为视觉表示学习的主导范式，然而现有方法产生的表示往往仍在一定程度上按模态而非按语义进行组织。我们提出ITO，一个通过两种角色不同、相互补充的机制来解决这一局限的框架。多模态多重对齐通过从多视图图像增广中构建多样的跨模态对应关系来丰富监督信号，提供了判别性增益的主要来源。随后，一个轻量级的训练时多模态融合模块充当训练时正则化器，促使编码器产生在融合下兼容的特征。关键在于，该融合模块在推理时被丢弃，从而在仅增加训练时开销的同时，保留了标准双编码器架构的高效性。研究在从数百万到数十亿规模的预训练上进行了大量实验。
tldr: ITO通过基于多视图增广的多模态多重对齐丰富监督信号，并引入仅在训练阶段使用的轻量级多模态融合模块作为正则化器（推理时丢弃），使图文预训练得到的表示更多按语义而非模态组织，同时保持双编码器架构的推理效率。
en_tdlr: ITO enriches image-text contrastive pretraining with multimodal multiple alignment built from multi-view augmentations, plus a lightweight fusion module used only during training as a regularizer (discarded at inference), yielding semantically organized representations while preserving dual-encoder inference efficiency.
